'''Blood brothers''' was a name given to an especially close bond between two people on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shiva IV]]. [[Aron Peacebringer]] and [[Kéral Longknife]] became blood brothers after signing the [[Concordat of Peace]], uniting the [[Calian Confederacy]] and the [[Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél]] after decades of fighting.
